output.sql:
SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
output.explanation: Adds up net_revenue for each customer over orders flagged is_revenue = true and dated in calendar year 2025, then returns the five highest totals with company names.
